title: PatchDiet local feedback data
description: Bounded local-only record of human review verdicts for one PatchDiet shrink run. Data format specification only: PatchDiet 0.2.0 has no feedback reader or writer; files in this format are manually authored and consumer-managed local records with no built-in collection, network access, or adaptive behavior.

cleanupDiffSha256.description: SHA-256 of .patchdiet/cleanup.diff at review time; binds verdicts to the exact reviewed bytes.

path.description: Repo-relative path with forward slashes. Rejects absolute Unix/Windows/UNC/drive-letter paths, empty, dot and dot-dot traversal segments, backslashes, and NUL/control characters.

allOf.description: Allowed character set only, at least one character; lookaheads reject empty (//) segments, a leading slash, and a trailing slash. The character class applies to every character, including the last.

reviewedAt.description: RFC 3339 date-time with explicit UTC offset or Z.

$comment: Consumer requirement (not automatic CLI enforcement): feedback files SHOULD be at most 4 MiB of UTF-8 encoding exactly one JSON object with no trailing data. PatchDiet 0.2.0 performs no enforcement of this file size because it neither reads nor writes feedback files; tooling that consumes this format must reject larger files. The 'format': 'date-time' assertion on reviewedAt follows RFC 3339.
